greet.warm: {speaker} greets {listener} warmly: "So good to see you!"

smalltalk.weather: "The marsh is breathing damp again," {speaker} remarks.

offer_food.kind: "Take it, you're skin and bones," {speaker} says, sharing food with {listener}.

insult.plain: "I wish I'd never laid eyes on you," {speaker} snaps at {listener}.

threaten.plain: "Try that again and you'll regret it," {speaker} hisses.
